title: Battle of Noisseville
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Noisseville", at revision 1370451815, opens: "The Battle of Noisseville on 31 August 1870 was fought during the Franco-Prussian War and ended in a Prussian victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q541081, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1870 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
